entries.name: sb_is_playing
entries.desc: Playback active flag (non-zero while Sound Blaster DMA playback is in progress, 0 when idle)

entries.name: sb_init_state
entries.desc: Initialization status / speaker state flag (2 = initialized / speaker enabled)

entries.name: sb_active_buf_id
entries.desc: Active audio double-buffer ID (1 = buffer 1 at 0x001F, 2 = buffer 2 at 0x061F)

entries.name: sb_buf_write_pos
entries.desc: Number of sample bytes currently written into active audio buffer (0 to 0x600)

entries.name: audio_buffer_1
entries.desc: First Sound Blaster PCM audio ping-pong buffer (0x600 bytes)

entries.name: audio_buffer_2
entries.desc: Second Sound Blaster PCM audio ping-pong buffer (0x600 bytes)

entries.name: sb_old_irq_vector
entries.desc: Saved old interrupt vector (far pointer offset:segment) for Sound Blaster IRQ

entries.name: sb_dma_cur_page
entries.desc: Physical 64KB DMA page number (bits 16-19) for current audio buffer chunk

entries.name: sb_dma_cur_offset
entries.desc: Physical DMA offset (bits 0-15) for current audio buffer chunk

entries.name: dma_chunk_count
entries.desc: Transfer count minus 1 for current DMA chunk

entries.name: sb_dma_page_crossing_flag
entries.desc: Flag/counter indicating whether playback buffer crosses 64KB DMA page boundaries (0 = single page)

entries.name: sb_playback_bytes_remaining
entries.desc: Total remaining audio playback byte count (32-bit low word: [0C35h], high word: [0C37h])

entries.name: sb_dma_end_offset
entries.desc: End physical offset (bits 0-15) of playback buffer (linear start + length - 1)

entries.name: sb_base_port
entries.desc: Sound Blaster DSP base I/O port address (e.g. 0x220)

entries.name: sb_irq_vector
entries.desc: Sound Blaster interrupt vector number (e.g. 7 for IRQ 7, 0x6A for IRQ 10)

entries.name: sb_sample_rate
entries.desc: Audio sampling rate in Hertz (e.g. 11025)

entries.name: sb_buffer_len
entries.desc: Total length of sound buffer in bytes (passed into playback function in BX)

entries.name: sb_buffer_offset
entries.desc: Offset in caller's segment (or CS) of sound buffer to play

entries.name: echo_delay_len
entries.desc: Echo delay buffer size/limit (max 0x0F6E, 0 = disabled)

entries.name: sb_driver_signature
entries.desc: Driver signature word (initialized to 0x1234 upon driver init)

entries.name: echo_write_idx
entries.desc: Echo delay buffer write index

entries.name: echo_read_idx
entries.desc: Echo delay buffer read index

entries.name: echo_saved_ah
entries.desc: Temporary storage for AH register during echo processing

entries.name: echo_buffer
entries.desc: Echo delay circular ring buffer (up to 0x0F6F bytes)

entries.name: sb_dma_mask_val
entries.desc: DMA single channel mask register value or port config

entries.name: sb_dma_mask_reg
entries.desc: DMA single channel mask port (e.g. 0x0A or similar DMA port register)

entries.name: dma_unmask_val
entries.desc: DMA unmask channel command byte (channel & 3 to unmask channel)

entries.name: dma_port_mask
entries.desc: DMA mask register I/O port (0x0A for 8-bit DMA channels 0-3)

entries.name: dma_port_clear_ff
entries.desc: DMA clear flip-flop register I/O port (0x0C for 8-bit DMA controller)

entries.name: dma_port_mode
entries.desc: DMA mode register I/O port (0x0B for 8-bit DMA controller)

entries.name: sb_dma_addr_reg
entries.desc: DMA channel address port register

entries.name: sb_dma_count_reg
entries.desc: DMA channel count port register

entries.name: sb_dma_page_reg
entries.desc: DMA channel page port register

entries.name: echo_saved_di
entries.desc: Temporary storage for DI register during echo processing

entries.name: sb_saved_ax
entries.desc: Temporary storage for AX register during driver operations

entries.name: sb_saved_dx
entries.desc: Temporary storage for DX register during driver operations

entries.name: sb_base_port
entries.desc: Sound Blaster base I/O port address parsed from BLASTER environment variable (e.g. 0x220)

entries.name: sb_irq
entries.desc: Sound Blaster IRQ parsed from BLASTER environment variable (e.g. 7 or 5)

entries.name: sb_dma
entries.desc: Sound Blaster DMA channel parsed from BLASTER environment variable (e.g. 1)

entries.name: env_segment
entries.desc: Segment of DOS environment block

entries.name: env_offset
entries.desc: Offset in environment block (initially 0)

entries.name: env_size_bytes
entries.desc: Size of environment block in bytes

entries.name: env_blaster_val_offset
entries.desc: Offset of '=' after 'BLASTER' in environment block

entries.name: str_BLASTER
entries.desc: Target string "BLASTER" (and lowercase "blaster") used to match environment variable name

entries.name: blaster_val_buf
entries.desc: Buffer storing the value string of BLASTER environment variable, terminated by CR LF '$'
